indications: Potassium chloride extended-release tablets are indicated for the treatment and prophylaxis of hypokalemia with or without metabolic alkalosis, in patients for whom dietary management with potassium-rich foods or diuretic dose reduction is insufficient.
contraindications: Monitor serum potassium and adjust dosages accordingly ( 2.1 ) If serum potassium is less than 2.5 mEq/L, use intravenous potassium instead of oral supplementation ( 2.1 ) Take with meals and with a glass of water or other liquid. Swallow tablets whole without crushing, chewing or sucking. ( 2.1 ) Treatment of hypokalemia: Doses range from 40-100 mEq/day in divided doses. Limit doses to 40 mEq per dose. ( 2.2 ) Prevention of hypokalemia: Typical dose is 20 mEq per day. ( 2.2 )
warningsAndPrecautions:
Potassium chloride extended-release tablets, USP contains 600 mg or 750 mg of potassium chloride (equivalent to 8 mEq and 10 mEq respectively. Potassium chloride is provided as extended release tablets.

                   Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F); excursions permitted between 15° to 30°C (59° to 86° F). [See USP Controlled Room Temperature.] Protect from light and moisture. Dispense in a tight, light-resistant container with a child-resistant closure.
adverseReactions: Potassium chloride is contraindicated in patients on triamterene and amiloride.
